info.name: Trustpilot Business Units Reviews API
info.description: Provides endpoints to retrieve company profile information, reviews, images, categories, and web links for specific business units on Trustpilot. Search for business units and access both public and private review data.

request.description: Fetch public reviews for a business unit with filtering and sorting options.
Retrieve paginated public reviews using pageToken cursor-based pagination, supporting up to 100,000 reviews.
Access private reviews including customer contact information and order IDs.
